maddeler.e:
أشتهر (form VIII)
# أَشْتَهِرُ (ʔaštahiru) /ʔaʃ.ta.hi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
# أَشْتَهِرَ (ʔaštahira) /ʔaʃ.ta.hi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
# أَشْتَهِرْ (ʔaštahir) /ʔaʃ.ta.hir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْتَهَرَ (ištahara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
